# ALSflow

> ALSflow is a Czech AI automation service that deploys and fully manages AI assistants for small businesses — handling emails, appointment booking, document processing, and customer replies. The client pays a fixed monthly fee and never touches the infrastructure.

## What ALSflow does

ALSflow builds and manages three core products for Czech small businesses:

- **AI Front Desk** — 24/7 automated appointment booking, cancellations, reminders, and FAQ responses via email (4,750 CZK/month + 8,000–10,000 CZK one-time setup)
- **Email Bot** — AI reads and replies to incoming customer emails automatically; add-on to AI Front Desk (2,750 CZK/month extra; bundle total 7,500 CZK/month)
- **PDF Extractor** — Converts invoices, intake forms, and supplier price lists into Excel automatically (1,750 CZK/month + 5,000 CZK one-time setup)
- **Full Bundle** — AI Front Desk + Email Bot (7,500 CZK/month)

## Who ALSflow serves

Primary: Appointment-based local businesses in Prague and major Czech cities (Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň, Liberec) — physiotherapists, veterinary clinics, dentists, hair and beauty salons, wellness studios.

Secondary: Freelancers and small firms (2–10 people) with high administrative burden.

Shared characteristic: Owner wears many hats, limited time, not technical, loses bookings due to missed calls or slow email replies.

## Why ALSflow

- Cheaper than hiring a receptionist (15,000–25,000 CZK/month)
- Fully managed — client never touches the system
- Czech language, Prague-based, personal service
- Available 24/7
- Email-based automation — works with any existing workflow, no app install required
